calculationFlow: Marketing spend: ₹25 cr; avg CAC for fitness app: ~₹250 (paid acquisition).
Of these, MAU at 6 months: ~30% = 3 lakh.
Of these, paying users (basic ₹500/mo or premium ₹2,000/mo): ~5-7% = 15K-21K paid users.
Year 1 paid subscriber revenue: 18K × ₹6,000 (avg time as paid = 7-8 months) = ~₹11 Cr.
Plus content commerce / in-app purchases: ~₹2 Cr.
Note: Year 1 will be loss-making (₹25 cr spend vs ₹15-18 cr revenue).

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Note: Year 1 will be loss-making (₹25 cr spend vs ₹15-18 cr revenue).
